method: Read-only IDA decompilation/disassembly and original/current byte comparison; sanitized diagnostic extraction and source review. No generator, compiler, test suite, benchmark, GUI or CI run for these changes.

report.symptom: Both peers in 3P disconnect/turn grey; local native solo continuation remains manually playable but floating one-shot is disabled.

orb.readReason: 戰鬥記憶體範圍未通過讀寫保護校驗

limits: The orb reader failed before reading descriptors, clocks or board data. Zero seat/count/status/flags/timer values are unread defaults, not device observations.
Battle's narrower impl+0x92000/0x2c000 range succeeds while the orb impl+0x92000/0x2e000 range fails. The log does not identify which exact page/protection caused the broader check to fail.
Mode 7 selector 2 is a separate concrete classification omission. Adding that mode alone would not fix the earlier memory gate failure.
The retained count 2..3, local status 3 and completed-cleanup predicates come from native source analysis and synthetic cases; this device log does not confirm them after the failed read.
report.privacy: Account identifiers, entry hashes, pointers, device/container paths and unrelated configuration are omitted.

native_evidence.finding: Co-op completion counts remaining descriptors excluding statuses 5/6. One remaining participant leads through sync 3 into native local continuation. The dylib does not call the sync dispatcher.

sub_10001C5F8 copies localSeat via sub_10000CEE0 then writes selector 2 at 0x10001C898. This mode 7 branch restores the native local bank, including its helper, instead of waiting for turnSerial modulo teamCount.
Calls sub_10000C5EC(impl+0xA3E48,1). The surrounding routine restores the saved battle phase and clears the team busy bit after native continuation.
Reset stores [0,0,0,UINT32_MAX] at context+9552 (impl+0xA6398), clearing sync and step. Argument 1 preserves the initial turn/count/local/view fields and local descriptor identity.
Input precheck sub_1000164F4 only uses the online co-op path for selectors 1/4; selector 2 reaches MOV W0,#0, skipping the retired turn-modulo/decision-clock gate.

The actual native input routine still checks recovery bit 0x40. Source at impl+0xAFE78 selects impl+0xAFE74 or impl+0xAFE7A; the latter byte is six bytes after the former. A blocking bit invokes recovery dispatch and prevents input.
Release performs online network/co-op timer work only for selectors 1/4; selector 2 bypasses that branch while retaining the ordinary native board gesture.
At 0x10000C624, STR WZR,[context+0xBAE0+0x548] clears context+49192 = impl+0xAFE70 network flags. The continuation reader requires completed cleanup rather than ignoring arbitrary flags.
Loads the local six-member source bank and sets viewTeam to localSeat. sub_10001956C/sub_100019BBC retain six-member mode 7 ownership independent of selector, including helper provenance.

change.entry_transition: Allow only Three to ThreeSolo within a verified entry; revoke old arm/worker/token. Reverse or unrelated kind changes remain latched until a verified new entry or exit.

memory.protection: Core and each used modal pointer require read+write and forbid execute. Every individual read still uses PHReadMemory protection. All eight enemy structures remain within the core.

native local descriptor active flag/bank address/protection confirmed; team busy bit 8 clear
syncState 0, syncStep 0, networkFlags 0, no continuation modal, selected recovery flag bit 0x40 clear

change.scope: Explicit local one-shot and read-only goals only. PHBattleIsSinglePlayer is unchanged; continuous input, skills, team/timer/BGM writes and damaging thorn contacts remain unavailable.
